none: PAS NLM-CF0E29: Roman Coin: Nummus of Valentinian I
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Valentinian I (364-375), Lyon mint Vota issue of 364-367, RIC volume 9 no. 14, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust draped and diademed cuirassed right; large eye. Obverse inscription: [DN VALENTINI] ANVS PF AVG. Reverse description: Vow in wreath: VOT / V / MVLT / X. In exergue: LVG. Diameter: 16.1mm, Weight: 1.78gms, die axis: 6
